description: This file is a C++ source file implementing warning reporting control logic, including classes for configuration, thread-local storage, singleton pattern, and warning event handling within the WPEFramework namespace.

classes.name: WarningReportingBoundsCategoryConfig
classes.description: A JSON container class for warning reporting bounds and category configuration, including report and warning bounds and category string.

classes.name: WarningReportingUnitProxy
classes.description: A singleton proxy class managing warning reporting, including event reporting, category management, and configuration.

classes.name: WarningReportingUnitProxy::BoundsConfigValues
classes.description: A class encapsulating configuration values for warning bounds, initialized from a JSON string.

classes.name: CallsignTLS
classes.description: A class providing thread-local storage for callsign strings, with static methods to get and set the callsign.

methods.name: WarningReportingUnitProxy::Instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of WarningReportingUnitProxy.

methods.name: WarningReportingUnitProxy::ReportWarningEvent
methods.description: Reports a warning event with module, filename, line number, class name, and event information.

methods.name: WarningReportingUnitProxy::IsDefaultCategory
methods.description: Checks if a category is a default category and retrieves its enabled status and specific name.

methods.name: WarningReportingUnitProxy::Announce
methods.description: Announces a warning reporting control category.

methods.name: WarningReportingUnitProxy::Revoke
methods.description: Revokes a warning reporting control category.

methods.name: WarningReportingUnitProxy::Handler
methods.description: Sets the handler for warning reporting and processes any pending categories.

methods.name: WarningReportingUnitProxy::BoundsConfigValues::BoundsConfigValues
methods.description: Initializes configuration bounds from a JSON string.

methods.name: CallsignTLS::Callsign
methods.description: Gets the current thread-local callsign string.
